learning_outcomes.text: Invoke Amazon Bedrock foundation models for text and chat tasks
Design prompts and request structured, controllable output
Build retrieval-augmented applications with knowledge bases
Secure Bedrock access with IAM and manage data handling
Evaluate quality, safety and cost of Bedrock applications
Deploy and monitor a Bedrock-backed application

integrative_case: Build a policy-answering assistant on Amazon Bedrock: pick a foundation model, ground answers in a knowledge base over company documents, enforce structured citations, restrict access with IAM, evaluate answer quality and safety, and deploy behind a monitored, cost-bounded API.
